title: Classic Wonders of Japan Group Tour
alt: Snow monkeys in a steaming hot spring at Yamanouchi, Japan
transport: Bullet trains, coaches and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station to begin, with a free evening in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the centre, walking distance from the park

activities.name: Hiroshima walking tour
activities.description: On foot through the Peace Memorial Park, the cenotaph and the A-Bomb Dome with a guide who tells the city's story properly.

activities.name: Miyajima island
activities.description: The ferry across to Miyajima for the floating torii gate, Itsukushima shrine and the tame deer along the shore.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A night in Hiroshima, arriving by bullet train, with the Peace Memorial Park and the island shrine at Miyajima the same day.

stops.name: Matsuyama
stops.hotel: ANA Crowne Plaza Matsuyama, an IHG Hotel
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Central hotel on Shikoku island, close to the castle hill

activities.name: Matsuyama castle
activities.description: One of only twelve original castle keeps left in Japan, up on its hill with a view across the Seto inland sea.

activities.name: Ishiteji temple
activities.description: A pilgrimage temple on the Shikoku circuit, with its gate, three storey pagoda and cave shrine behind the main hall.

activities.name: Dogo Onsen
activities.description: The oldest hot spring bath house in the country, a wooden warren of pools said to be three thousand years old.

program.name: Matsuyama
program.description: A night on Shikoku island with the original castle keep, a pilgrimage temple and Japan's oldest hot spring bath house.

stops.name: Kobe
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel out on the harbour pier at Meriken Park

activities.name: Kotohira shrine, Ritsurin garden and Uzu no Michi
activities.description: A touring day across Shikoku: the hillside Kotohira shrine, the landscaped Ritsurin garden and the glass floor walkway above the Naruto whirlpools.

program.name: Kobe
program.description: A night on the Kobe waterfront, reached on a touring day through Shikoku's gardens, shrines and the Naruto whirlpools.

stops.name: Mount Koya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Temple room · 3★ · Working temple lodging on Mount Koya, with its own hot spring bath

activities.name: Kobe earthquake memorial museum
activities.description: The museum built after the 1995 quake, which explains in plain terms what happened to the city and how it rebuilt.

activities.name: Mount Koya sightseeing tour
activities.description: The temple town itself: the Garan complex, Kongobu-ji and the cedar lined Okunoin cemetery with its two hundred thousand graves.

program.name: Mount Koya
program.description: A night in a working temple lodging on the mountain, with the Garan complex and the Okunoin cemetery walked in the afternoon.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.hotel: The Prince Kyoto Takaragaike, Autograph Collection
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in gardens north of the city centre

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: A night in Kyoto with a guided day through the temples and a free evening in the Gion lanes.

stops.name: Nagano
stops.subtitle: Nagano to Tsumago and Matsumoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel attached to Nagano station

activities.name: Tsumago post town
activities.description: A preserved post town on the old Nakasendo road, where the wooden inns and shopfronts look much as travellers found them.

activities.name: Matsumoto castle
activities.description: The black keep they call the crow castle, standing on its moat with the Alps behind it, another original from the sixteenth century.

program.name: Nagano
program.description: A night in Nagano, reached through the old post town of Tsumago and the black keep of Matsumoto castle.

stops.name: Ikaho
stops.subtitle: Ikaho to Kusatsu and Nikko
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Ryokan room · 3★ · Traditional inn at Ikaho hot spring, with tatami rooms and shared baths

activities.name: Zenkoji temple
activities.description: Nagano's great temple, home to what is said to be the first Buddhist statue brought to Japan, kept hidden behind the altar.

activities.name: Snow monkey park
activities.description: The hot spring at Jigokudani where wild macaques sit chest deep in the steaming water, often with snow on their heads.

activities.name: Kusatsu hot spring town
activities.description: Free time in Kusatsu, where the hot water runs down wooden channels through the middle of the town square.

activities.name: Nikko sightseeing tour
activities.description: The lacquered Toshogu shrine in its cedar forest, the Shinkyo bridge and the Kegon falls on the way back to Tokyo.

program.name: Ikaho
program.description: A ryokan night at a hot spring, with the snow monkeys, Zenkoji temple and Kusatsu on the way, and Nikko on the final day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: This is the Japan that regulars come back for. Temple lodgings, an island shrine, a monkey hot spring and the old post towns.
expert.tip: The night at Fukuchi-in on Mount Koya is the highlight. Eat the vegetarian temple dinner, then join the morning prayers at six.

summary: Ten days on a group tour that leaves the usual trail: Tokyo and Hiroshima, then Shikoku island for an original castle and the oldest bath house in Japan, a temple lodging on Mount Koya, Kyoto, the old post town of Tsumago, the snow monkeys and a ryokan night before Nikko.
included: Included: 9 nights across eight towns with daily breakfast, including a temple lodging on Mount Koya and a ryokan at Ikaho; bullet trains and coaches throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Hiroshima, Kyoto, Mount Koya and Nikko; Miyajima island; Matsuyama castle, Ishiteji temple and Dogo Onsen; Kotohira shrine, Ritsurin garden and the Uzu no Michi walkway; Kobe earthquake memorial museum; Tsumago and Matsumoto castle; Zenkoji temple, the snow monkey park and Kusatsu.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
